Each path confirms the same dependency: \( \text{DB} \) is unreachable. The \( \text{DB} \to \text{unreachable} \) condition triggers \( \text{create} \to \text{throw} \to \text{exit} \) in all write paths, preventing any \( \text{IngestionRun} \) creation. This leads to \( \text{ok:false} \) in \( \text{refreshOdds()} \), and \( \text{credit governor} \) reports \( \text{remaining=null} \), indicating no run occurred. The \( \text{null} \) signature distinguishes \( \text{never ran} \) from \( \text{ran but exhausted} \). Thus, the system's failure is not due to provider issues or budget exhaustion, but due to \( \text{DB} \to \text{unreachable} \).
